title: Experiment Validity & Duration
description: Intermediate path covering the validity threats that appear once an experiment is running: peeking, carryover effects, day-of-week bias, sample ratio mismatches, and how to set duration correctly so the result is trustworthy.
focus_concepts: TYPE I AND TYPE II ERRORS
outcomes: You'll determine the right experiment duration, detect peeking and carryover bias, interpret sample ratio mismatches, apply variance reduction to tighten confidence intervals, and read a result correctly when multiple metrics are tested simultaneously.
